這應該算放送事故了吧⋯🌸快關台前☄️打語音進來⋯聲音軟到不行⋯真的是我從沒聽過的☄️⋯是那種只會對自己的情人撒嬌的那種軟度，而且這感覺是（每天？）睡前情侶間會打的那種電話⋯🌸很快就意識到☄️以為自己已經關台了便立刻提醒她自己還在（C part）說話（🌸控糖又來了）⋯一開始☄️還沒搞清楚狀況還在發奶音，直到🌸再次用很商業的聲音提醒☄️問她今天狀況如何，☄️才遲疑了一下然後像是突然驚醒一樣，問🌸，欸？妳還沒關台？🌸回她，沒關喔。然後☄️馬上切換回商業聲音說話⋯
這個☄️的聲調切換的過程實在太經典了，我相信這會變成未來回顧她們情史的一個重要事件。

I would call this a broadcasting accident…soon before🌸ends her stream☄️made a call to🌸, and☄️‘s voice was the kind of tenderness I have never heard. You can tell it’s that type of call couples make (everyday?) before they go to bed. 🌸immediately knew it’s because☄️thought🌸was already off stream so🌸hinted her she is still talking (as c part - again this was🌸trying to cut down your sugar intake)☄️didn’t catch that in the beginning and was still talking softly, so🌸hinted her again with her business tone and asked☄️how was her day. ☄️seems a bit confused first and then all of a sudden☄️realized she was on a live stream, and asked🌸, you are not off stream yet?🌸replied, no, this is still live, then☄️immediately switched to her business tone just like her partner…
This incident of☄️changing her tone of talking was an instant classic, I have no doubt that I am witnessing a historical moment of their love.
